newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kampo, Yucho post forex profits from foreign bonds.
newsitem.headline: Kampo, Yucho post forex profits from foreign bonds.

text.p: Japan's Postal Life Insurance Bureau (Kampo) and the Postal Savings Bureau (Yucho) posted currency profits from their foreign bond holdings as of end-March 1997, an official for the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications said on Thursday.
Kampo's currency profits from its foreign bond holdings stood at 205 billion yen as of end-March 1997, the official said.
Yucho's currency profits from its foreign bond holdings totalled 36.5 billion yen as of end-March 1997.
The figures were calculated at an exchange rate of 124.10 yen to the dollar.
The official said the currency profits were due to the yen's weakness against the dollar during fiscal 1996/97,which ended on March 31.
In 1995/96, Kampo posted losses totalling 223.9 billion yen on its foreign bond holdings.
Yucho's currency losses from its foreign bond holdings totalled 297.6 billion yen as of end-March 1996.
